subject.title: fix(doctor): recover sibling moltbot.json config dropped on upgrade (#54200) [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw accept bounded doctor recovery for sibling `.openclaw/moltbot.json` after that config filename was retired?
rationale: The patch is a strong fix for a real upgrade regression, but it deliberately creates a compatibility exception for a retired filename that may hold credential-bearing config.

options.title: Land Scoped Doctor Recovery
options.body: Accept the compatibility exception because recovery stays in doctor/startup guidance, keeps runtime resolution canonical, and has focused safety coverage and terminal proof.
